reranked_evidence.title: For Dalit-Muslim unity, Mayawati must focus on caste, not religion | SabrangIndia
reranked_evidence.snippet: # For Dalit-Muslim unity, Mayawati must focus on caste, not religion. ### The most backward among Muslims come closest to the Dalits when it comes to shared experience in facing Hindutva's wrath. For instance only 62% of Jatavs, who are the BSP’s mainstay, voted for the party, down from the whopping 86% who did in 2007, which was when it won a majority for the first time. Conducted between the last week of July and the first week of August this year, the pre-election survey showed 62% of Muslims supporting the Samajwadi Party, a substantial gain from votes the party polled from the community in 2012 (39%) and 2007 (45%). For a Dalit-Muslim consolidation to happen in the BSP’s favour in UP, and give her an edge in the election sweepstakes, CSDS’ Verma says, it will have to poll Dalit votes close to what it bagged in 2007 and also double its Muslim votes from the 20% it notched in 2012.
